'''Melitene''' is [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]]'s ''[[der'sul'dam]]''.

== Appearance ==
She has long, graying hair, less black than gray. She was an experienced woman, both in her craft and in catching nuances.

== Activities ==
Along with Captain [[Musenge]] and [[Furyk Karede]], she leads a group of ''[[damane]]'' and ''[[sul'dam]]'' to hunt down Tuon. She laughed about Mylen's fierce wanting to find Tuon, and her worship of Tuon.{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Melitene}}

When the camp where Tuon is held is found, she goes with Karede to meet with the camp's leader. She holds [[Sheraine Caminelle]]'s (Mylen) ''[[a'dam]]''. She then goes with Karede and Tuon back to [[Ebou Dar]].

She is present when Tuon warns King [[Beslan Mitsobar]] not to cause a revolt against the [[Seanchan]].

She brings Fortuona [[Suffa]], the former [[Amyrlin Seat]] who shows Fortuona and those gathered around her how to [[Traveling|Travel]]. Fortuona decrees that all ''damane'' are to learn the weave in preparation for a full-scale attack on the [[White Tower]] using Traveling to transport the army there.
